$comment: Watched areas of the g2way repo. Each area is a set of upstream paths whose content is hashed (git tree/blob OIDs) and recorded in g2way.lock.json. When an area's OID moves, `npm run check:g2way` fails and names the dashboard surfaces that depend on it. Edit `paths` when g2way grows a file this dashboard reads; edit `surfaces`/`onChange` when the dashboard side moves.

areas.onChange: Re-copy the spec and regenerate types; check the BFF proxy allowlist for new or removed endpoints, and where each write reads its org (body org_id vs ?org_id=, ADR-0007).

surfaces: Auth editor (M5): authProblems and AUTH_DEFAULTS in src/lib/apis/auth.ts mirror AuthConfig::validate and its serde defaults
areas.onChange: New or changed ApiDefinition fields need form controls, validation and a migration for stored config history.
The --apps-dir file layout or accepted extensions moved: check bundleFiles() still writes what load_dir() reads, and the README's duplicate-id caveat.
A new AuthConfig mode needs its own editor branch and an explain-panel entry.
Rate/quota/access shape changes ripple into the key editor, the shared access matrix (ApiAccess/TypeFields fields and their help) and the 'what does this key allow' resolver.

surfaces: Visual chain designer (M5): src/lib/apis/chain.ts (CHAIN_SLOTS, chainFor), src/components/apis/chain-view.tsx
areas.onChange: The slot order/count is the designer's canonical ordering — re-read the ChainBuilder rustdoc and update it.

surfaces: Chain view (M5): applyVersion in src/lib/apis/chain.ts mirrors VersioningConfig::apply
Form checks (M5): TRANSFORM_METHODS and isIpOrCidr in src/lib/apis/auth.ts mirror transform.rs and security.rs

Path-rule editors (M5): ruleProblems, HOP_BY_HOP and MOCK_DEFAULT_STATUS in src/lib/apis/rules.ts mirror PathRule/MockResponse/EndpointRateLimit::validate (endpoints.rs) and UrlRewriteRule::validate (transform.rs)

Versioning editor (M5): versioningProblems, DEFAULT_VERSION_KEY and FORM_OVERRIDES/DEFERRED_OVERRIDES in src/lib/apis/versioning.ts mirror VersioningConfig::validate and VersionOverrides (versioning.rs)

Transform and CORS editors (M5): headerTransformProblems, bodyTransformProblems, corsProblems and the BODY_/CORS_ defaults in src/lib/apis/transforms.ts mirror HeaderTransforms::validate (transform.rs), BodyTransforms/BodyTransformRule::validate (body_transform.rs) and CorsConfig::validate (security.rs)
areas.onChange: New transform or rule kinds need editors; check whether validation rules changed. A new VersionOverrides field, or a change to which fields apply() replaces, must be reflected in applyVersion.
New execution modes or config blocks need studio support (UDG sources, federation, cache).
ABI or PluginRef changes affect upload validation and the documented host interface.
AnalyticsRecord field changes need an ingest migration and rollup updates.
Redis key schema or analytics sink names changed — the ingest worker reads these keys directly.
Ports, Services or env changed — recheck that the dashboard can still reach the admin API in-cluster.

surfaces: Chain explain panels (M5): SLOT_DOCS and SLOT_ADRS in src/lib/apis/slot-docs.ts cut passages by file and heading (slot-docs.test.ts fails on a renamed one)
areas.onChange: Re-vendor contracts/g2way-docs/; a new ADR may change a decision this dashboard relies on. A moved or renamed doc section needs its SLOT_DOCS entry updated; a new doc about a chain slot deserves one.
